name: Find That Book golden set
how_verified: Canonical work = for (title, author): GET /search.json?title=..&author=..&sort=editions; among works whose normalized main title equals the expected title, the one with the most editions.
Author-only rows: GET /search/authors.json?q=<name>; every author record with that exact name is listed (Open Library has duplicate author records).
Every query was also run raw (GET /search.json?q=<query>&limit=10); observed_live records the raw top-1 and numFound as evidence of difficulty, not as the expectation.
Extra acceptable ids are listed only where Open Library has a second record for the same book, and the note says why.

scoring.top1: candidates[0].work_id in expected.top1 (author rows: candidates[0] has an author in expected.author_keys, or author surname = expected.author_surname)
scoring.top5: any of candidates[0..4] in expected.top5 (author rows: any of the first 5 by the author)
scoring.status: response.status in expected.status ('rejected' = QueryValidator refused the query, as the API does, and the error code equals expected.error_code)
scoring.rows without top1/author: no-answer rows: only status is scored; any 'match' is a false positive
scoring.rejected rows: expected.status = ['rejected']: the runner runs QueryValidator first, exactly like the API; the row passes only if the query is rejected with expected.error_code (HTTP expected.http_status). Not answerable: no top-1/top-5. Any accepted query is a status error, and a 'match' on it is a false positive.
scoring.match_precision: among status = match: share whose top-1 is right and whose row allows 'match' (the headline: a wrong match is the costly error)
scoring.coverage: share of answerable rows returned as match

changelog.change: 60 cases in 14 categories, expectations verified against live Open Library (see how_verified).
none-04 ('?!? ... ###') now expects HTTP 400 validation_failed: QueryValidator rejects it before the pipeline runs. v1 expected a 200 with status none.
changelog.reason: Brief R2 (DE-05 supersedes plan 02 section 7.1): after trimming and removing control/format characters a query must contain at least one letter or digit in any script, else 400 validation_failed. v1 followed the superseded plan 02 rule (200 none because the raw string is non-empty).

changelog.change: Added per-row tuning flags in_sample (every row) and in_hard_set (query also in research/07-fix-misses/hard.jsonl). Expectations of every other row are unchanged from v1.

tuning.detail: Every row was run while the research rules were designed and tuned (research/05-08, the plan 04 fixes, the plan 06 v3 ablations replayed this set on cached live responses). in_hard_set marks the 30 queries that are also in the research hard set (research/07-fix-misses/hard.jsonl, 46 rows), which was in-sample too. Numbers on this set measure regressions and fidelity to the prototype, not generalization.
tuning.held_out: eval/heldout.json (sealed: never tune on it; the eval runner refuses it without --heldout and labels its results HELD-OUT)
